claim_statement: Eligibility criteria by subcategory: (1) `EB-1A` Extraordinary Ability in the sciences, arts, education, business, or athletics requires sustained national or international acclaim proven by either a one-time major internationally recognized award (e.g., Nobel Prize, Oscar, Olympic Medal) or at least 3 of 10 regulatory criteria under 8 CFR § 204.5(h)(3); (2) `EB-1B` Outstanding Professor or Researcher requires international recognition in an academic field (at least 2 of 6 regulatory criteria), at least 3 years of teaching or research experience, and a tenure-track or permanent research offer from a U.S. university or qualifying private research employer (employing at least 3 full-time researchers); and (3) `EB-1C` Multinational Manager or Executive requires having been employed outside the United States for at least 1 year in the preceding 3 years by a qualifying foreign parent, subsidiary, affiliate, or branch of the petitioning U.S. employer (which must have been doing business in the U.S. for at least 1 year) to work in a managerial or executive capacity.
